resolutions.researcher_notes: Status 'operating' is inferred, not literal. OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 ('Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2012') lists the UBTG-1/Berri lines as existing/in-service Saudi Aramco gas pipelines; the CATgroup contractor record describes the 'UBTG-1 Sales Gas Project' as an active Master Gas System line undergoing PCV/meter-station upgrades (implying an in-operation trunk). Two independent origins both consistent with operating. gem.wiki (seed only) also states operating. OPEC direct flipbook URL 403s to bots; cited the verified Wayback snapshot.

Fuel 'Gas' confirmed by two independent sources: OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 is explicitly titled 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members' and lists the UBTG-1/Berri lines under Saudi Arabia; the CATgroup record names it the 'UBTG-1 Sales Gas Project' within Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System.

Length 247 km supported by OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10, which lists the 'UBTG-1 km 0/Berri' Saudi Aramco line at 154 miles (154 x 1.60934 = 247.8 km, matching the 247.00 km sheet value). Single-source (OPEC ASB only, one publication family; gem.wiki 248 km derives from the same OPEC data and is not independent). Note: the table actually shows TWO adjacent 'UBTG-1 km 0/Berri' rows — 155 mi/56 in and 154 mi/36-38-40-42 in — which GEM appears to have merged into this single 'UBTG-1-Berri 2' entry (247 km = the 154-mi row). No independent corroboration of the exact length found; flag for possible segmentation review.

Diameter '56, 36, 38, 40, 42 in' supported by OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10: the two 'UBTG-1 km 0/Berri' Saudi Aramco rows carry 56 in and 36/38/40/42 in respectively; combined they yield exactly the sheet's 56, 36, 38, 40, 42 set. Single-source (OPEC ASB only). Consistent with the merged-segment interpretation noted under Length.

Location Saudi Arabia confirmed by two independent sources: OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 lists the UBTG-1/Berri lines under the Saudi Arabia section; Saudipedia confirms the Berri Gas Plant is a Saudi Aramco facility in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province. Only country-level endpoints are populated in the sheet; both endpoints Saudi Arabia.

Owner1 'Saudi Aramco' 100% confirmed by two independent sources: OPEC ASB2013 Table 4.10 names 'Saudi Aramco' in the Owner/operator column for every UBTG-1/Berri row; the CATgroup contractor record places the UBTG-1 Sales Gas line inside Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System. Consistent with all Saudi Arabian gas transmission being Aramco-owned/operated.
